annotations.title: Scan a website for accessibility issues

description: Use this when the user wants a public website or web page checked for accessibility (WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA, ADA, EAA, Section 508): it loads the live page in a real browser, runs axe-core on it and up to two more same-site pages, and returns a 0-100 score, a letter grade and the failing rules with example elements. Takes 15-40 seconds. Do not use it for pages that need a login, for localhost or private-network addresses, or for pasted HTML.

url.description: Public website address, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/about

name: scan_accessibility

moreInfoUrl.description: Informational page on scheduled re-scans and fix help for this kind of result.

needsReviewCount.description: Checks axe could not decide automatically; a human must confirm them.

rulesOmitted.description: Failing rules not listed because the response is capped.
